correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge3\), \(2\le k<n\), and \(s\ge0\), the positive quadratic root t fixes the semiaxes. The exact support identity \(a^2p^2+b^2(1-p^2)-(1+sp)^2=(s/t)(p-t)^2\) proves all-direction containment. Equality normals yield exactly k+1 spherical contact orbits, whose normalizations have a finite zero-mean covariance-\(I_n/n\) certificate. Averaged quadratic containment for an arbitrary competitor and AM-GM force its volume at least as large with equality only for the proposed ellipsoid. Differentiation of the exact semiaxes gives \(d\log(\mathrm{vol})/ds=k/(s+t)\), whose derivative is strictly negative. The separate standard-library verifier checks 510 exact rational configurations and 3060 exact support differences, with the infinite result proved analytically.

value.rationale: The unit-ball parallel body of a regular embedded simplex is a natural archetype of rounded polytopes and unions/convex hulls of congruent balls. The result evaluates a nontrivial unrestricted extremal invariant for all intrinsic/ambient dimensions and all real scales, classifies all contact strata, proves the universal dimension-only normalized contact split \(k/n\) and \((n-k)/n\), and establishes strict logarithmic concavity of optimal volume. These structural and equality statements are not mere specialization of the known generic ellipsoid algorithms.
